versions.subject: Merge PR #4830 from @frack113 - Enhance Wbadmin based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'WBADMIN.EXE'
selection_backup:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' recovery'
        - 'recoveryTarget'
        - 'itemtype:File'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\config\SAM'
        - '\config\SECURITY'
        - '\config\SYSTEM'
        - '\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wbadmin.exe" OR OriginalFileName="WBADMIN.EXE" CommandLine="* recovery*" CommandLine="*recoveryTarget*" CommandLine="*itemtype:File*" CommandLine IN ("*\\config\\SAM*", "*\\config\\SECURITY*", "*\\config\\SYSTEM*", "*\\Windows\\NTDS\\NTDS.dit*")
